checks.name: Actual generated portraits bind unchanged PNG sources and retain selection-only, edition and crop scope
The composite preserves older defaults except qualified R34 replacements and explicit source-edition holds
A final proof contains at least one actual generated and reviewed R34 combat body
The default resolver stays lazy, preserves current registry identity and all stable aliases
New R34 defaults reject missing full-body reference, combat-pose, direction and appearance qualifications
Historical presentation fails closed before qualification and keeps held media separate from a future qualified body
The held-media boundary wraps every render entry and never delegates a blocked or loading qualified pose
An early boundary survives later real adapter installation and repeated tail mounts without exposing held media
A real unheld R34 idle never falls back while decoding and qualified native choices retain priority
The builder derives visible-body scope only from all reviewed source qualifications and rejects opposite default direction
Historical replacements require the exact retained SHA and cannot create or duplicate a fighter
An actual new whole-body PNG draws one right-facing idle and keeps all action, side and actor fallbacks
Actual optional source decoding recovers from credit pressure without changing its default or edition admission
Actual new body corruption, pending-decode cancellation and page restoration release all credits
Only both explicit DEV parameters select the exact legacy registry

scope: Actual PNG bytes decoded by @napi-rs/canvas; current composite registry, lazy resolver, qualification faults, explicit historical and legacy contracts. Body-specific proof requires actual generated R34 body output. Synthetic contracts and delayed decoders are labelled fixtures; no original-game pixel, idle-cycle or global1:1 certification.
